title: Find the previous-token head
description: This checkpoint predicts the previous token at every position. Identify the attention head that routes that token into the output, then support your claim with an ablation.
behavior: For an input sequence t₀, t₁, …, predict tᵢ₋₁ at every position i > 0.
learning_objectives: Use ablation to test causal importance
hints: Inspect the row for a later sequence position.
The relevant attention is concentrated on position i−1.
Ablate your candidate and compare accuracy.
task_goal: Find the layer and head that carry the previous token, then demonstrate that ablating it damages the target behavior.
example_note: The first position has no previous token and is excluded from the accuracy metric.

explanation.canonical_solution: Inspect the proposed mechanism, measure a causal intervention, and confirm it on held-out examples.
explanation.caution: Attention patterns alone do not establish a causal explanation.

grading_contract.checks: The first component must be {type: "attention_head", layer: 2, head: 1}.

grading_contract.type: list[{type: ablation, layer: int, head: int, measured values: float}]
grading_contract.checks: Must contain an ablation of the submitted head with drop ≥ 0.5. The grader replays it on public and hidden sequences; hidden baseline must be ≥ 0.95 and mean hidden drop ≥ 0.5.

tool_reference.name: tools
tool_reference.description: A helper object passed into solve(...). Use it to measure behavior and inspect or intervene on this challenge model.

tool_reference.name: tools.evaluate(dataset)
tool_reference.description: Measures task performance across records. Returns accuracy, correct, and total.

tool_reference.name: tools.attention(tokens, layer, head)
tool_reference.description: Returns the attention matrix. Row i shows where the query at token position i reads; columns are key positions.

tool_reference.name: tools.ablate_head(tokens, layer, head)
tool_reference.type: dict: {type:str, layer:int, head:int, before:float, after:float, drop:float}
tool_reference.description: Temporarily zeros one head and measures task accuracy before and after. Records an ablation event; drop is before minus after.

tool_reference.name: tools.ablation_sweep(tokens)
tool_reference.description: Runs ablate_head on every head for one token sequence, sorted by largest accuracy drop. Pass tokens, e.g. dataset[0]["tokens"], not the whole dataset.

tool_reference.name: tools.activation(tokens, name)
tool_reference.description: Reads a named activation tensor, such as a residual stream or MLP activation.

tool_reference.name: tools.logit_lens(tokens, layer=None)
tool_reference.description: Projects a residual stream through the unembedding to see token scores at a layer.

tool_reference.name: tools.weight(name, layer=None, head=None)
tool_reference.description: Reads a model weight matrix, such as W_Q, W_K, W_V, or W_O.
